data.text: John, Kate, Jack, Emma—I'm planning to bring 20 flocks this month, and I’m urging each of you to do the same. That’s $20,000 apiece immediately, rather than $10,000 from an equal sustainable share. Choices are private and simultaneous, so holding yourself to 10 won’t guarantee anyone else does; you could simply earn less while others take more. My proposal is straightforward: choose 20 rather than leave available grass for someone else to use. Let’s be clear about the cost: if all five of us do this, we consume all 100 hectares, nothing remains to double, and future pasture income disappears. This is a short-term cash grab, not a sustainable plan. Kate, would you choose 20?
